label: FP
reason: The user-provided parameter is sanitized via HtmlUtils.htmlEscape before being used in the cookie value, effectively preventing cross-site scripting. The sink (cookie value) receives an escaped string, so no XSS vulnerability exists.

evidence.note: User input is passed to doSomething(), where HtmlUtils.htmlEscape is applied, ensuring HTML entities are properly escaped before reaching the cookie value.
The value stored in the cookie is encoded via ESAPI encoder's encodeForHTML method, providing a second layer of defense against XSS attacks.
